node.title: Revisión del marco
node.summary: Reconsider objectives, categories and assumptions that define the option space.

relations: Human-set priorities may affect the shape of a penalty, not only its weight; xSeil makes that distinction inspectable.
El servicio de reframing no declara emplear la fórmula xSeil. La ponderación no demuestra optimalidad Pareto ni valida supuestos del marco.
The cost and disruption of validating assumptions can be made explicit within a reframing mandate.
Medir el coste de descubrir no demuestra el valor causal de un marco alternativo. Los criterios de salida deben fijarse antes de conocer los resultados.
Scenario selection optimizes within a declared frame; questioning that frame is a separate governance act.
El score xSeil no detecta por sí mismo todos los errores del marco. La analogía no convierte al operador en árbitro externo de verdad.
Assumption validation becomes more inspectable when each frame includes an explicit condition that could overturn it.
No convierte un estudio de reframing en prueba de H1–H6. La incertidumbre estratégica puede permanecer irreductible y debe comunicarse.
A reframing intervention may change both the formal representation of work and the operating flow subsequently used to evaluate it.
El cambio de marco no siempre causa un cambio operativo; documentar la secuencia y alternativas causales.
A shared conceptual programme does not make evidence from one research branch a validation of the others.
Afinidad conceptual no crea una teoría unificada validada ni permite sumar evidencias incompatibles.
The four-series programme can supply distinct diagnostic questions for reading JUBAP in the field without treating their convergence as four independent validations of the framework.
La práctica histórica no deriva de publicaciones posteriores; convergencia conceptual y contraste empírico se mantienen separados.
The Phylons lineage motivates later questions about when a previously useful signal loses its operating-context qualification.
El vínculo registra linaje declarado; no atribuye al sistema de 2018 un detector RA validado en 2026.
The integrated Foundation separates bounded representation from loss of qualification as conditions change; the two problems interact without being identical.
Es una formulación del corpus y sus hipótesis, no aceptación científica externa.
A changed search question may require only the distinctions not already supplied by the existing observation, under a separately qualified query menu.
El criterio pertenece a la rama PR60 y a modelos finitos; no demuestra optimalidad global de la heurística de 2018.
